## Engineering Motivation
Explain the photovoltaic or power-electronics problem this enhancement addresses.

## Proposed Formulation & API
Outline equations, references (e.g., IEC / EN 50530 / IEEE papers), and expected inputs/outputs.

## Verification Plan
Describe analytical, limiting-case, or `pvlib` reference tests that will validate the feature.
